description.value: OoH La La Shwarma Bar is a fast-food shawarma and kebab spot on the busy Fraser Highway corridor in Surrey. It serves Middle Eastern-style wraps and grilled meats in a quick-service format. Cyclists riding the Fraser Highway route through Surrey may find it a convenient stop for a filling, protein-rich meal.
